title: eulophia aequalis
intro: Eulophia aequalis, commonly known as the Yellow Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia aequalis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory congestion, and soothe coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
